issues.description: Example code lies about its own iteration pattern
issues.detail: `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` is gratuitously clever and wrong-shaped. If you want the first node, write `pipeline.nodes[0]`. If `nodes` isn't indexable, say so. Copy-pasted into user code this becomes cargo cult. BAD-TASTE: the generator adds zero value over indexing.

issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable code masquerading as an alternative
issues.detail: The function returns the URL form, then has a commented-out data URI return below it. A reader skimming sees two returns; one is dead. Split into two named functions or use a parameter. Don't teach people to leave dead returns in their code.

issues.description: CustomPreview example uses `...` literals that won't run
issues.detail: `"nodes": [...]` and `"edges": [...]` are not valid example payloads. Either show a real minimal node/edge or say `# nodes go here`. As written, copy-paste produces a runtime Ellipsis in JSON serialization. Docs examples should compile and run.

issues.description: Pipeline node examples are missing imports and are not self-contained
issues.detail: The standalone `node(...)` calls in Mermaid and Text sections reference `process_data` and `calculate_metrics` that are never defined, and omit the `from kedro.pipeline import node` import in those snippets. Either make each snippet runnable or mark it as a fragment. Currently it's neither.

THREE-PATCHES: (1) docs for preview_fn, (2) Vale headings exception for JSON, (3) Vale ignore.txt adding lowercase `polars`. The Vale changes belong in their own commit with a one-line rationale. Bundling unrelated config tweaks into a docs PR is exactly the kind of thing that makes blame archaeology painful six years out.

issues.description: Author's own checklist admits missing RELEASE.md note and tests
issues.detail: The PR description has unchecked boxes for RELEASE.md and tests. For a docs-only patch the tests box is fine to skip, but a user-facing feature getting documented should land with a RELEASE.md line. State it or check it; don't leave the checklist visibly half-done.

review.summary: Documentation patch for an experimental `preview_fn` feature. Content is broadly useful and the warning banner is appropriate, but the example code has the kind of small sloppiness that propagates: a gratuitous `next(... for ...)` where indexing would do, dead-code return statements, Ellipsis literals where real example data belongs, and snippets that reference undefined functions. Also bundles two unrelated Vale config tweaks into a docs PR — that's three patches in a trench coat. NEEDS-WORK: fix the examples so they actually run as written, split out the Vale config, then land.
